'''Adam Wechsler Wexman's Scanning Crew Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Adam Wechsler]]
* '''Published:''' December 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Cloud City]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star: Central Core|Premiere-D-deathstarcentralcore.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Wexman's Scanning Crew Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCC Wexman's Scanning Crew Deck Wechsler.txt |Download]]
